versions.content: AUTOSAR shall provide data exchange formats to support work - share in large inter and intra company development groups Type: Valid Description: AUTOSAR shall support the work - share in large development projects via well - def ined exchange formats. Rationale: A typical AUTOSAR system is expected to carry a huge number of signals per vehicle. To develop vehicle descriptions a good organization of work - share is needed. To support such organizations, well defined concepts for i nformation exchange are required. Use Case: Data sharing between OEM and 1 st Tier supplier.
